Name: Smart Spin - Pre-fill Optimal Wager
Author: JonathanFeenstra
Description:
[size=5][b]Smart Spin[/b][/size]

This mod automatically calculates and pre-fills the optimal wager when placing a bet on the Spinning Wheel in the Stardew Valley Fair. The amount is calculated using the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelly_criterion#Gambling_Formula]Kelly criterion for binary return rates[/url], based on your current amount of star tokens, luck level, and chosen colour.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

The following settings can be configured in the config.json file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url] (German and Spanish localisations are included):

[list]
[*][b]Green probability[/b]: Sets the base probability of landing on green, not accounting for lucky speedups.
[*][b]Calculate with lucky speedups[/b]: When enabled, the probabilities of lucky speedups will be included in the overall probability calculation.
[*][b]Kelly fraction multiplier[/b]: Adjusts the wager by multiplying the Kelly fraction by this value. Increase for more aggressive betting, decrease for more conservative betting.
[/list]
The first two settings are provided so this mod can be adjusted to work well with other mods that change the win probabilities of the Spinning Wheel.
